about: plan_budget.py's own numbers: the repaint and re-record reserves, how big a filming piece is, memory, the 2-hour stretches, disk and the filming watch. The prices and the measured frame costs and memory it uses live in money and filming (lazy loading follows from filming.memory_per_piece_gb).

repaint_share.source: Plan 34 money table (one repaint per two paintings; lesson 97: Flux's strength varies)

rerecord_reserve_pages.source: Plan 34 money table (re-record reserve one page, about US$0.30)

stretch_margin_minutes.unit: minutes kept spare in each 2-hour stretch
stretch_margin_minutes.source: Design log 35 (2 h minus 10 min = 6,600 s); lesson 69 (background jobs stop after 2 hours)

piece_load_share_max.unit: share of a piece's time spent loading
piece_load_share_max.source: Design log 35 (PIECE_FRAMES = load / (0.10 x seconds a frame)); not tested by filming

restart_loss_max_seconds.unit: seconds of filming a restart may lose
restart_loss_max_seconds.source: Lesson 71 (60-frame pieces lose at most about 13 minutes on the slowest pages); design log 35 (floor(900 / seconds a frame))

memory_reserve_gb.unit: GB kept free for the system
memory_reserve_gb.source: Design log 35 (workers <= (free GB - 2) / (2.6 x views a page))

busy_machine_factor.unit: times slower while Blender renders alongside
busy_machine_factor.source: Plan 34 seconds a frame (held with smoke 0.9-1.3 s alone, 2.0-2.3 s while another Blender runs); round 5 filmed pages 3-5 in 110 min against round 4's 53 min while other helpers ran Blender (set also changed)

film_copies.unit: copies of the film on disk at once (pieces and the joined film)
film_copies.source: Plan 34 F2 (delete pieces after the silent film is checked)

disk_free_reserve_gb.source: Helpers' house rule (keep above 4 GB free disk)

stalled_after_piece_times.unit: times a piece's filming time with no new file
stalled_after_piece_times.source: Design log 35; lesson 56 (filming stopped silently for 90 minutes after a restart)
